provenance: New English translation; E2790-E2799 and E2880-E2889 reviewed alongside the owned source slice.
context: Fiore requests delivery protection; Cyrus crafts a protective charm; Fiore returns from an unsuccessful attempt to become the savior.
decisions: Cross-row sentences retain source breaks. Item and monster names follow glossary; Balmar Guard is a provisional item spelling. E2879 continues into E2880.

translations.en: But the monsters kept interfering,
and a crucial item needed to finish the circle got broken.
So the request to deliver a replacement
ended up coming to me.
As long as I'm carrying this item,
I think the monsters are more likely to come after me.
So I need you to protect me with everything you've got!
Whaaat? Why, why, why?!
Have you lost your nerve already?
Honestly! Now I'm in a fix.
What am I going to do?!
Hello, hello! @7rFiore Delivery Service@0r
has a job for you!
Is she still doing that?
Didn't she say she was thinking of quitting?
Ignoring your silent grumbling, @7rFiore@0r continued.
This time, the job pays really well.
It's a delivery to someone exploring @6rGraham Labyrinth@0r.
The item's valuable, so I'd like you to guard me.
The package is for an adventurer who seems to want
to do something about this town, just like you.
Fellow sufferers should stick together, right? Huh? Is that not a saying?
Oh, well. Anyway, it's bound to be dangerous,
so I really, really want you to be my escort!
Stop copying the way I talk!
Oh, come on. It's not costing you anything.
Anyway, that's the escort job. What do you say?
Did my @7rTanya@0r impression actually work?
You received @3rDemon's Contract@0r.
Welcome back.
If you're back, I guess everything went well.
Let's get right to it. Give me the materials.
You handed all the requested materials to @7rCyrus@0r.
Just a moment. These are all I need to finish it.
There we go.
Here, this is your reward.
As your reward, @7rCyrus@0r gave you
a @7rDemon's Contract@0r.
It might not be very powerful,
but it's a charm that softens attacks from demons a little.
The demons put a bounty on you, right?
I think it'll help protect you.
This is about all I can do.
I just made it so you can keep fighting.
I've caused you plenty of trouble, after all.
Besides, if you don't keep fighting for us,
we won't have a future. Don't let them beat you.
With that, @7rCyrus@0r smiled bashfully.
Did you get the materials?
Oh, not yet...
I know it's tough, but please keep at it.
I have a really important favor to ask.
So please don't refuse. In fact, you absolutely have to go.
The seriousness in @7rCyrus's@0r voice made you listen closely.
I'm thinking of making a charm.
I'd like you to collect the materials for it.
There are four things I need:
a @3rCockatrice Feather@0r, @3rHylde Moer's Tears@0r,
@3rThe Pretty's Wing@0r, and @3rFenodyree's Beard@0r.

translations.en: I've heard you can get them in the lower levels of @6rGraham@0r.
Of course, whatever's waiting down there could be strong.
Do your best out there.
Since he began by saying you couldn't refuse,
this probably has something to do with the seal.
It seems you'll have to steel yourself and gather the materials.
You received a @3rBalmar Guard@0r.
Ahh, seriously, thanks for all your hard work.
Well, oh mighty savior @7rFiore@0r? Think you can save the world?
How should I know?!
One thing's for sure: the savior isn't ME!
Well, the monster really was there,
and you managed to defeat it. Couldn't that be enough?
Sure, but... Huh? What's that outstretched hand for?
When you asked to be paid for this adventure,
@7rFiore@0r looked ready to burst into tears.
D-don't tell me you're demanding payment from a poor maiden
who's crushed because she failed to become the savior?!
Well, what did you expect?
Helping with @7rFiore's@0r grand adventure was a job, after all.
Exactly. Fiore may be a pitiful would-be savior,
